scope: one temporal motif window under joint exchangeability of scored site histories
surrogate: Fisher-Yates shuffle site indexes once per draw and apply the same index order to every scored training and test prefix; preserve the multiset of site histories and every frame histogram
pipeline: reuse the exact temporal training gate, per-draw motif and Huffman refit, held-out score, signed charged gains, and conservative rank from the independent frame permutation evaluator
controls: a repeated stationary frame with distinct labels must tie under shared-site permutation; compare with independent frame permutation; independently replay a nonstationary fixture and verify preservation of the site histories
limits: synthetic engineering fixtures only. Inference requires joint invariance under shared site permutations. Population calibration for this new null remains open.
